text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the attempt.
Even though you couldn't get it,
it's shifted to a flatter spot.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No, it doesn't bother me anymore now. It really doesn't, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Leaving that aside...
I am curious about the craftsmanship of the plushie.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Would it be all right if I peeked in for a moment? Even just learning by watching...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
